items.details:
On activation, for 10 seconds, autoclicks: * 1 times per second * with \left(C \times R \times S^{1+0.5 \times R} \times 100 + 1 \right) \times P_{C} \times P_{A} \times (1 + C_{C} \times C_{P}) profit per click While {{SpellTooltip|spell_name=Rules Of Nature}} is active, each autoclick grants:
\left( \frac{A}{1000} \right)^{0.4} \times R
charges. Has a maximum of 2 000 000 charges. Consumes all charges on use. where: * C = \text{Weapon Charges} * S = \text{Summoning Efficiency} * A = 1000 \leq \text{Autoclicks This Exile} \leq 1\mathrm{e}8 * R = \frac{1 + 0.75 \times \text{Tier}}{4} * P_{C} = \text{Click Profit} * P_{A} = \text{Autoclick Profit} * C_{C} = \text{Crit Chance} * C_{P} = \text{Crit Profit} Tiers: * \text{Common} = 0 * \text{Uncommon} = 1 * \text{Rare} = 2 * \text{Epic} = 3 * \text{Legendary} = 4 * \text{Unique} = 4

items.details:
When activated at 0 charges, gains charges over 10 seconds, equal to:
R \times 6 \times \left\lfloor G \times 24 + C \times 5 + H \times 2.8 + M \times N \times 2.72 + F \times 4 + T \times 5 + I \times 6 \right\rfloor When activated with charges, consumes all charges to grant temporary Hellholes while active (10 seconds), equal to charges consumed. where: * G = \text{Goblet of Fire Casts Since Activation} \times 6 * C = \text{Casts of the Following Spells Since Activation:} ** \text{Fire Ball} ** \text{Hellstorm} ** \text{Meditative Fury} * H = \text{Hellstorm Ticks Since Activation} * M = \text{Meditative Fury Ticks Since Activation} * N = \left\lfloor \frac{\left\lfloor \log_{10}(M_E) \right\rfloor - 1450}{26.2712} \right\rfloor + 1 * M_E = \text{Mana earned this exile} * F = \text{Fireball Ticks During Activation} * T = \text{Summon Infernal Thrasher Ticks During Activation} * I = \text{Summon Horned Incinerator Ticks During Activation} * R = \frac{1 + 0.75 \times \text{Tier}}{4} ''Note: Ticks usually happen once per second, but can be slower due to frames.'' If less than 1e1450 mana this exile: * N = 1 Tiers: * \text{Common} = 0 * \text{Uncommon} = 1 * \text{Rare} = 2 * \text{Epic} = 3 * \text{Legendary} = 4 * \text{Unique} = 4

items.details:
For 10 seconds, each manual consumes all available Hallowed Clicks, granting the sum of their profit, equal to:

<math>P_{C} \times (1 + C_{C} \times C_{P} / 100) \times P_{H} \times N^H</math>

Each evocation cast charges by:

<math>(R + 1) \times 5\%</math>

where:
* <math>P_{C} = \text{Click Profit}</math>
* <math>P_{H} = \text{Hallowed Click Profit}</math>
* <math>C_{C} = \text{Crit Chance}</math>
* <math>C_{P} = \text{Crit Profit}</math>
* <math>N = \text{Hallowed Clicks Consumed}</math>
* <math>H = 1 + 3 \times R^2</math>
* <math>R = \frac{1 + 0.75 \times \text{Tier}}{4}</math>

Tiers:
* <math>\text{Common} = 0</math>
* <math>\text{Uncommon} = 1</math>
* <math>\text{Rare} = 2</math>
* <math>\text{Epic} = 3</math>
* <math>\text{Legendary} = 4</math>
* <math>\text{Unique} = 4</math>

items.details:
Multiplies Evocation efficiency by:
N^{5 - E} Multiplies Incantation efficiency by:
N^{5 - I} Multiplies Summoning efficiency by:
N^{5 - S} where: * E = \text{Evocation Ingredients} * I = \text{Incantation Ingredients} * S = \text{Summoning Ingredients} * N = (B+1)^{R} * B = \text{Current Amount of Laboratories} * R = \frac{1 + 0.75 \times \text{Tier}}{4} \times 0.065 Tiers: * \text{Common} = 0 * \text{Uncommon} = 1 * \text{Rare} = 2 * \text{Epic} = 3 * \text{Legendary} = 4 * \text{Unique} = 4 Considering that each elixir requires 1 ingredients for one kind and 2 each from the other 2 kinds, it means that you always get N^4for the ingredient less requested in the recipe of an elixir, and N^3for the other two. For Evocation Elixir the former is the Anima (evocation related) component, so you get the best bonus at Evocation Efficiency. Similarly Summon Elixir gets the best bonus in Summoning Efficiency. The two remaining ones, Pet and Shadow Elixir, receive the best bonus in Incantation Efficiency instead.
